title: FilingFrequencyChangedPayload
description: Payload of the FilingFrequencyChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity whose filing frequency changed.

oldFrequency.description: Filing frequency before the change, e.g. MONTHLY, QUARTERLY.

affectedSpan.description: The span of prescribed periods the new frequency applies from.

fromPeriod.description: First prescribed period the new frequency governs.

toPeriod.description: Last prescribed period the new frequency governs, absent when open-ended.
